title: Dock
description: One rail of every renderer beside a stage that holds them, with shelf pages pinned below: click a mark or press ⌃1…⌃9 to show one.

home.description: The renderer the dock opens on when its address names none. Unset, the config's `renderer` unless that is the dock, else `page`.

order.description: Renderers drawn first on the rail, in this order; the rest follow in the tower's order.

pins.description: Shelf entries pinned to the rail below the renderers, by floor and label, so reordering a shelf doesn't move them: `initials` and `color` over the ones drawn from the label.

marks.description: Each renderer's mark on the rail, by name: `initials` (one to three characters) and `color` (any CSS colour) over the ones drawn from its name, and `label`, the name its tooltip shows, over its extension's title.
